$comment: Slide 1 of 6: hook. The rough message is the site's own example.
headline: One rough message. Eight ways to send it.
rough: hey can u send the file tonight its kinda urgent

headline: For when you just need it done.
tones: Can you send the file tonight? It's fairly urgent.
Hey, can you send the file tonight? Kinda urgent.

headline: For your manager, or for your friend.
tones: Could you please send the file this evening? It is time-sensitive.
Can you send the file tonight? Can't wait to dig in!

headline: For the group chat that deserves it.
tones: Prithee, send the file ere night doth fall. 'Tis most urgent.
Arr, send the file tonight, matey. It be urgent.

headline: For when the file really is that urgent.
tones: One file. One night. And time is running out.
The file. Tonight. In this town, urgent means yesterday.

headline: Choose your tone once. Then just talk.
body: Eight tones, every app, 800 words a month free.
